_comment: Spells of the Player's Handbook (2024), PDF pages 242-346. Names, pages and classification only.

entries.name: Command
entries.note: adapted: always Grovel; the other four words come with choices in battle (Part C)

entries.name: Guidance
entries.note: adapted: adds 1d4 to ability checks with every skill, not one chosen skill

entries.name: Hold Monster
entries.note: adapted: with a higher slot the extra targets are the nearest others in range

entries.name: Hold Person
entries.note: adapted: with a higher slot the extra targets are the nearest others in range

entries.name: Identify
entries.note: adapted: outside a fight only; no ritual casting yet (Expansion 3)

entries.name: Lesser Restoration
entries.note: adapted: also eases a disease taking hold, since the game's diseases have no other magical cure before Expansion 3

entries.name: Sleep
entries.note: adapted: the caster's choice of creatures is 'enemies only' (the battle has no per-creature choice yet)

entries.name: Spirit Guardians
entries.note: adapted: enemies inside start their turn at half speed (not halved for every step taken inside)

entries.name: Stoneskin
entries.note: adapted: the diamond dust is not spent yet (material components: Expansion 3)

entries.name: Web
entries.note: adapted: the webs do not burn away under fire yet
